description: Get the popularity of a player among padel fans by providing their player ID (Padel Fan Index), measured over a window (last 12 months by default). Returns fan_share (percentage of fan interest that went to the player), popularity_rank (position by fan_share), popularity_index (fan interest against the interest expected for the player's level, 1.0 = as expected, 2.0 = twice), fan_share by month and its trend (rising, stable or declining). Every value is relative to the rest of the circuit, never an absolute fan count. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.

after_date.description: Start of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 12 months before before_date.

before_date.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

player_id.description: The ID of the player to get the audience for.

name: show-player-audience
